lines.1: While I looked something up on the computer, Crab arrived with a manga and started reading on my bed.
lines.2: 「Neither Subaru nor Fukahire came over today.」
lines.4: Subaru was probably working his night job.
lines.5: 「Fukahire joined the student council for the Princess and Yoshimi, but why do you think Subaru joined?」
lines.6: 「He probably didn't think too hard about it. If it gets annoying, he'll just quit.」
lines.8: 「Pretty much. I just hope it keeps me from getting bored.」
lines.10: 「You don't own a single stuffed animal. I'm using this instead.」
lines.16: 「Oh, here we go. Because the Princess likes tea, right?」
lines.18: 「But the tea we happened to drink today was good too.」
lines.19: 「Come to think of it, your manners at the tea party were terrible.」
lines.20: 「What are you talking about? There's no point acting all fancy around friends.」
lines.21: 「You acted that way around people who weren't your friends too.」
lines.22: 「What do you want from me? I've never been anywhere classy. I wouldn't know what to do.」
lines.23: 「Wait. You've never attended parties? Your dad is a famous scholar.」
lines.24: Yes. That was the truth, in fact.
lines.25: 「He says there's no need for me to come. I always stay home.」
lines.26: ...Her parents really had abandoned her, hadn't they?
lines.37: 「Get off my bed. Better yet, go home.」
lines.38: 「Otome doesn't visit your room very often, does she?」
lines.40: 「It's only been three days since she moved in.」
lines.41: 「I see. Then I'll go to bed too. Night.」
lines.42: With that, Crab climbed out the window.
